\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 179-182 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R187-first-pass-words-from-chapters-179-182}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to save and to deposit.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to take a shower, to pick up, to watch, to look at, to listen
  \item to mix, to stir, to boil, to fry, to chop
  \item to breathe, to tidy, to shake, to cross, to stroll
  \item to book, to hire, to repeat, to translate, to talk
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To take a shower? (\textbf{\fa{دوش} \fa{گرفتن}}, \emph{dush gereftan}.) To pick up? (\textbf{\fa{برداشتن}}, \emph{bardâshtan}.) To watch? (\textbf{\fa{تماشا} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{tamâshâ kardan}.) To look at? (\textbf{\fa{نگاه} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{negâh kardan}.) To listen? (\textbf{\fa{گوش} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{gush dâdan}.) To mix? (\textbf{\fa{مخلوط} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{makhlut kardan}.) To stir? (\textbf{\fa{هم} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{ham zadan}.) To boil? (\textbf{\fa{جوشاندن}}, \emph{jushândan}.) To fry? (\textbf{\fa{سرخ} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{sorkh kardan}.) To chop? (\textbf{\fa{خرد} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{khord kardan}.) To breathe? (\textbf{\fa{نفس} \fa{کشیدن}}, \emph{nafas keshidan}.) To tidy? (\textbf{\fa{مرتب} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{morattab kardan}.) To shake? (\textbf{\fa{تکان} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{tekân dâdan}.) To cross? (\textbf{\fa{رد} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{rad shodan}.) To stroll? (\textbf{\fa{قدم} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{qadam zadan}.) To book? (\textbf{\fa{رزرو} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{rezerv kardan}.) To hire? (\textbf{\fa{استخدام} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{estekhdâm kardan}.) To repeat? (\textbf{\fa{تکرار} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{tekrâr kardan}.) To translate? (\textbf{\fa{ترجمه} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{tarjome kardan}.) To talk? (\textbf{\fa{صحبت} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{sohbat kardan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
